title: Unnamed major: 'We got it from them'
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida

tellings.quote: He looked at me and went, "We got it from them."

plain: Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor, says that in 1992 at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida he saw a UFO inside a secret hangar. He tells Michels that an Air Force major, whom he does not name, looked at him and said, "We got it from them." If true, it would mean the military held a craft it credited to non-human makers.
